title: 深度智联·地产数据 MCP 对接配置
title_en: DeepLink Real Estate Data MCP Configuration
description: 连接深度智联房地产数据服务（使用经克而瑞授权的数据），用于查询新房、二手房、土地、企业、宏观等数据。API Key 仅保存在您的本机，不会上传或同步到 WorkBuddy 云端；连接时通过 HTTPS 请求头发送给深度智联服务完成鉴权。
description_en: Connect to the DeepLink real estate data service using CRIC-licensed data for new homes, resale, land, enterprise, and macro data. Your API Key is stored only on this device and never uploaded or synced to WorkBuddy cloud; it is sent to the DeepLink service over HTTPS request headers for authentication when connecting.
docLabel: 如何获取深度智联 API Key？
docLabel_en: How to get a DeepLink API Key?

fields.label: API Key
fields.placeholder: deeplink-sk- 开头，在深度智联平台个人中心自助创建
fields.placeholder_en: Starts with deeplink-sk-, created in your account console
fields.description: 用于访问深度智联地产数据服务的专属密钥，按查询次数消耗预付积分。
fields.description_en: Your dedicated key for the DeepLink data service. Queries consume prepaid credits.
